title: Successive list drops
statement: Let $x,u,r$ be Boolean lists and let $p$ be a natural number. If dropping the first $p$ entries of $x$ leaves the concatenation of $u$ and $r$, then dropping the first $p+|u|$ entries of $x$ leaves $r$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean lists x, u, and r
